interventions.detail: pip and setuptools must be present in the env: paddle imports setuptools and paddlenlp imports pip (created venv with uv --seed, Python 3.10)
paddlenlp 3.0.0b4 breaks with aistudio-sdk 0.3.x (no aistudio_sdk.hub.download); resolved deps with --exclude-newer 2025-03-20 (aistudio-sdk 0.2.6)
installed paddlepaddle==3.0.0 CPU wheel from the paddlepaddle.org.cn CPU index (README just points to the website)
used dtype float32 instead of float16 on CPU
